In the headlines: “Sensex Today Ends 417 Points Lower | Nifty Below 23,900 | ITC & Trent Losers” (Equitymaster). “US-Iran War Live Updates: IRGC Navy says three tankers hit mines, catch fire in Strait of Hormuz” (The Indian Express).
One session says little about the long run. Oil, the Iran war and foreign flows remain the big swing factors.

drivers.p: Brent is down 6.0% in a week. India imports most of its crude, so cheaper oil eases inflation, supports the rupee and helps oil users.
The rupee is at 92.90 per dollar, stronger than a week ago. A firmer rupee eases import costs and tends to steady foreign investors.
